name: cache-tax
description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: warn shows the rewrite price and still sends. refuse holds your first cold message once and asks you to resend.

autoWarm.title: Auto keep-warm after a paid cold write
autoWarm.description: on arms a 3h keep-warm window by itself, which sends a model request about every 50 minutes. off only extends a window you opened with /keepwarm.
